<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/set_node_run_commit/{project_guid}/{workflow_guid}/{node_guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Pins (or clears, with an empty string) the git commit a node's runtime
executions are pulled from. This is runtime state stored outside git, so
it doesn't create a commit or propagate to clones; the runtime is reloaded
so a running node picks up the new pin on its next (re)start. Rejected
with 409 while the node is running, since the pin should never change out
from under an active run.
